01.12.2025 WPPIL No.34 of 2025
Hon’ble G. Narendar, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
Mr. Sagar Kothari, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. B.S. Parihar, learned Additional C.S.C. for the 
State.
3. The Additional Secretary (Revenue), Government of 
Uttarakhand and the District Magistrate, Dehradun are 
present virtually. The Additional Secretary (Revenue) 
would submit that the Secretary (Revenue) is on leave till 
04.12.2025. 
4. The learned District Magistrate would submit that 
earlier an extent of 37 hectares was recorded as land being 
part of the Yamuna river; that in 1951 settlement 
proceedings were taken up and except for half bigha the 
remaining extent of land was recorded in the name of two 
families; that the entries recording the names of two 
families have been reaffirmed by way of a correction order 
passed by the then DM in 1963. 
5. The records relating to the said piece of land and the 
records relating to transfer of revenue entries in favour of 
the two families be placed on record.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner shall array the said 
parties as party respondents to the instant petition.
7. The original records be produced before this Court on 
the next date of hearing.
8. List on 04.12.2025. 
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (G. Narendar, C.J.) 
 01.12.2025 01.12.2025 
Rajni

of hearing is dispensed with.
